title: Land Development
intro: Hey, {playerName}! How are you doing? Is your water tasting and looking funny, too?
I’ve been noticing ever since I moved to this part of town, the water’s been blackened and polluted with soot and oil leakage.

Do you have any ideas of what I could do to make this safer for my family and our neighbors? What options do we have? Unfortunately there’s so much damage now I’m starting to think there’s no real solution except moving away from here!
